note: Tag keys a facility, hub or destination record may carry. Each tag names the source it came from. Tier cited = a named page; harvested = a public register or dataset fetched by a tool; field = someone stood there. The validator currently rejects a tag at the tradition and inference tiers.

entries.label: International patient office
entries.evidence: the hospital's own international-patient page, or a directory entry naming the department

entries.label: Interpreters on staff
entries.evidence: the facility's own page naming the languages, or a published inspection or accreditation report

entries.label: Publishes prices
entries.evidence: a public price list or package page on the facility's own site, read on a dated visit

entries.label: No published price
entries.evidence: the facility's own site carries no price for the procedures it advertises, checked on a dated visit

entries.label: Sells packages
entries.evidence: a bundled price on the facility's own page covering more than the operation

entries.label: Bills foreign insurers
entries.evidence: the facility names the insurers or schemes it bills directly

entries.label: Public hospital
entries.evidence: a ministry register, a national health service list, or the hospital's own statement

entries.label: University hospital
entries.evidence: the affiliated university's own page or the hospital's charter

entries.label: Part of a hospital group
entries.evidence: the group's own list of hospitals, or a filing naming the parent

entries.label: Publicly listed
entries.evidence: an exchange listing or an annual report

entries.label: Transplant programme
entries.evidence: a national transplant registry, a ministry licence list, or the facility's own programme page

entries.label: Treats children
entries.evidence: the facility's own paediatric department page or a ministry register

entries.label: Teaching hospital
entries.evidence: a recognised training post list or the hospital's own statement

entries.label: Publishes outcomes
entries.evidence: a registry submission, an annual clinical report, or a national outcome dataset naming the unit

entries.label: LGBTQ+ welcoming
entries.evidence: the facility's own statement, a named clinic programme, or a public directory of welcoming providers — read off one of those rather than inferred from a name or a photograph

entries.label: Women's hospital
entries.evidence: the facility's own charter or a ministry register

entries.label: Faith-founded
entries.evidence: the founding body's own statement or the hospital's charter

entries.label: Helps with the visa
entries.evidence: the facility or ministry names the letter or invitation it issues, with the visa class

entries.label: Airport transfer
entries.evidence: the facility's own package terms

entries.label: Recovery accommodation
entries.evidence: the facility's own page naming the hotel or its own ward-hotel

entries.label: Complication cover included
entries.evidence: the written terms of the package, naming what is covered and for how long

entries.label: Closed
entries.evidence: a closure notice, a ministry deregistration, or reporting that names the date
